- Market structure: **SIDEWAYS by the stated rule, and the header says DOWNTURN in error.** Spot is 18.5% under the $73.43 4-week high ($59.88 / $73.43 = 0.8155), short of the 20% line. VXN is 28.55, past the 25 line, so only the volatility leg of DOWNTURN is met. Spot is 19.2% above the 4-week low, short of the 30% line for RALLY. DOWNTURN would need a close under about $58.74 (0.8 × $73.43), 1.9% below spot. The label is fragile.
- Trend: below the 50DMA by 15.91% and below the 200DMA by 8.6%. Spot is 31.74% under the 52-week high and 61.1% above the 52-week low.
- Volatility & premium environment: VXN is 28.55, up 6.77%. Chain ATM IV is 0.69 and IV/HV is 0.65 (HV20 106.1%). IV/HV under 1 means options cost less than the stock has actually been moving, so sellers get no extra cushion. Premium is large in dollars, but swings are large too. Chain IV of 69% is about 20% under the ~86% implied by the 3x-VXN rule of thumb, which is itself only an estimate.
- Put-selling context: HOSTILE. The stage is 5, six of seven lenses are bearish, spot is under both moving averages, VXN is rising, and the news engine flags CAUTION with Nvidia and Iran headlines. IV/HV of 0.65 means premium is cheap relative to realized movement. A close above the 200DMA near $65.51 with HY OAS under 3.25% would be the first real softening. Context only — no strikes, expiries or sizes.
